summary: Backend-only audit-fix verification (iter 111b). Ran the existing 41-test finance suite (41/41 pass) plus a new 29-test suite (tests/test_iter112_audit_fixes.py, 29/29 pass) covering: RBAC gate _require_fin on /api/finance/bank-recon/* (gudang 403 on 11 read+write endpoints, finance/accounting 200, admin 200), adjust period guard (400 'di luar periode sesi'), in-period adjust → JE to session bank account + cash movement + auto-match, legacy /api/rahaza/finance/bank-recon-adjustments post → cash movement (category bank_adjustment, source_module bank_recon, gl_je_id) + balance -2500 + repost 400 (not 500) + type 'other' direction from expense/income account, balance-sheet orphan_account_lines, regression ar-aging & bank-recon summary. DB verified clean before/after; no orphan journal_lines. No backend defects found.

minor.issue: Suite deleted the QA customer but not the auto-created customer subledger COA `1-1301-QC<SFX>`; 4 leftovers had accumulated across earlier runs (coa_accounts 291→295). FIXED by me: purged the 4 unreferenced leftovers from Mongo and added `db.rahaza_coa_accounts.delete_many({'code': f'1-1301-QC{SFX}'})` to the teardown. COA total is now stable at 292 across runs.

Each run permanently adds +1 voided maklon_ar_invoice JE (po-mk-demo-2 regeneration). JE count grew 11 → 13 over my two full-suite runs. Owner-accepted per brief, but seed JE count will keep drifting upward on every future run — consider deleting the voided JE created by the run in teardown.

critical_code_review_comments: Verified all 22 @router endpoints in routes/dewi_bank_reconciliation.py go through _require_fin/require_perm (script-checked, no gap). Gate fires before session lookup → 403 not 404, confirmed dynamically for import-bulk/auto-match/adjust/approve/match/internal-check/delete.

_FIN_ROLES resolves to (superadmin, admin, owner, accounting, staff_keuangan, manager_keuangan, finance, manager, director) — matches spec. /approve stays stricter (finance.approve|finance.manage, no 'manager'/'director' legacy) which is intentional but is an inconsistency worth documenting.

fulfillment.finalize_fulfillment_dispatch guard is sound: reuses saved_shp['items'] + fg_cogs_consumed_at so consume_fifo is skipped on retry, and post_cogs_shipment is itself idempotent via source_ref 'cogs:{shipment_id}' (_find_existing_je) so a retry cannot double-post COGS.
rahaza_bank_recon.post_bank_adjustment: `except HTTPException: raise` is placed before the generic handler → 400 no longer leaks as 500 (verified: repost returns 400).

POST /api/rahaza/cash-accounts ignores a client-supplied `gl_account_code`; the GL code always comes from coa_auto.ensure_subledger_for_entity (1-1200-<CODE>). Not a bug, but the brief's example payload is misleading — sessions correctly pick up the auto-created code.

rca_of_the_issue: Only defect found was a test-data leak, not product code: POST /api/rahaza/customers-side flow auto-creates a COA subledger (1-1301-<customer code>) via coa_auto.ensure_subledger_for_entity, and test_iter108_finance.py teardown removed the customer but not that account, so each run left one dangling COA row (4 accumulated). Purged the unreferenced rows (verified 0 JE lines / 0 mirror lines referenced them) and added the delete to the teardown; COA total is now stable at 292 across consecutive runs.
